chapter: Erroll Garner and the Los Angeles scene
title: Meeting Erroll Garner in New York and Los Angeles
summary: He knew Garner from 52nd Street and then at the Suzy Q.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: In the time you were in California, Erroll Garner was out there. Had you known him before in New York?
Yeah, I had met him in New York.

When he waas on 52nd Street, yeah. But I didn't really get to know him well until I was working at the Streets of Paris and he was at the Suzy Q (I think that was the name of the joint) in Hollywood. In between sets, we used to run and see each other. So that's about as much as I can recollect about what was happening at that particular spot. But we used to run... After each one got off of a set, sometimes his sets would be staggered so he could go off and hear me and I could go off and hear him. But we didn't have too much of that going on. Some of the nights the schedules were just the same, so that made it of rough.
